lines.en: I sway slowly, dragging my chain.
The ash in my censer stirs softly.
I draw a ring of smoke along the floor.
Each step rings one iron link.
My steps are slow, never stopping.
The scent arrives before I do.
I pace down the corridor.
The smoke crawls along the ground.
Too dry here; the ash stings.
I swing my chain, looking for a place.
With the mouth down, the smoke scatters.
I turn a corner and the smoke follows.
I sway along the base of the wall.

lines.zh: 炉盖晃开一线，烟漏出来。
lines.en: The lid slips a crack and smoke leaks out.

lines.zh: 我把链子提了提，免得绊住。
lines.en: I lift the chain so it will not snag.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方留着香味。
lines.en: A scent lingers where I have passed.
I sway slowly and never stop.
The chain rubs out a low sound.
Ash gathers in the censer's floor.
I am waiting for someone to speak.
The smells here are too mixed.
I sway slowly so the smoke stays even.
Old scratches line the censer wall.
I cannot tell directions.
Someone is coming this way.
I can smell as far as twenty-four blocks.
My incense is nearly spent.
A little more swaying.

lines.zh: 墙角有风，我把炉口转开。
lines.en: There is a draft; I turn the mouth away.
I count the times the chain rings.
Have you come to confess too?

lines.zh: 炉里没有眼，可我闻见你了。
lines.en: There are no eyes in this censer, but I smell you.
You are standing rather far off.
Come a little closer.
Your hands are not clean.
I know without looking.

lines.zh: 你也来忏悔？先站到炉口前。
lines.en: Here to confess? Stand before the censer first.
Everyone here has that smell.
I have no eyes, and I still see.
What do you have to say?
The censer wall is dented in.
Ash spills across the floor.
The chain rattles out of rhythm.
My sway has gone crooked.
That blow left me dull.
I make no sound, only iron.
A corner of the incense has gone out.
I steady myself slowly.
This iron is thicker than it looks.

lines.zh: 香炉一晃，烟就从缝里漏。
lines.en: One sway and smoke leaks from my seams.
A censer does not eat.

lines.zh: 你把食物放进来也没用。
lines.en: Putting food in me is useless.
I burn incense, not meals.
That smell is far too faint.
I carry a scent of my own.
Take it away; do not mask the incense.
Keep it and eat it.
Ash settles on my brass rim.
That smell distracts me.
Set it down and step back.
You touched my chain.
An iron link rings once.
I sway once and steady.
Do not push me; the ash will spill.
I turn a different way.
You are blocking the censer's mouth.
The smoke goes around you.

lines.zh: 你碰响我的铁链，香灰撒了。
lines.en: You clang my chain and ash spills out.
Now the smoke flows right.
Standing over there is better.
A censer does not grow such things.
I am made of iron and ash.
You ask the wrong thing.

lines.zh: 我只管把烟熏匀，别的不问。
lines.en: I only keep the smoke even; I ask nothing else.
I only tend the smoke.

lines.zh: 我是铁和灰做的，别多想。
lines.en: I'm made of iron and ash — don't get ideas.
There is only ash within.
Step back.
Ask another question.
I sway and give no answer.
I pick up what falls to the ground.
My chain has caught it.
I pin it under the censer base.
There is ash on it.
Whose did it fall from?

lines.zh: 链子缠住它了，我拖了两步。
lines.en: My chain snags it and I drag it two steps.
I cannot hold this steadily.
You pick it up instead.
There are a few more on the ground.
I do not bend over.
You are within my twenty-four blocks.
I have your scent.
The smoke turns toward you.
The censer mouth faces you.
I need not come closer.
This one comes from far off.
Retreat, and you are still in range.

lines.zh: 二十四步内，你已经在我的烟里。
lines.en: Within twenty-four paces, you're already in my smoke.
Then strike first.
Let me hear your confession.
I sway and slowly aim at you.
The smoke's direction does not lie.
You are circling to the side.
My censer turns to follow.

lines.zh: 烟的方向不会骗人，你在这边。
lines.en: Smoke doesn't lie — you're on this side.
That is better still.
I have incense enough.
I hear your breathing.
There is no cover here.
How long will you keep hiding?
A lance of smoke strikes at you.
A pinch of ash flies from the censer.
I swing in, and the chain arrives first.
This one comes from the side.
You dodged the first wisp.
The second hugs the ground.
I burned a handful of incense.
Smoke gathers at your feet.
The fumes push you back half a step.
I sway slowly back again.

lines.zh: 我被人从架子上取下来。
lines.en: Someone lifted me from the shelf.
The incense in me is still warm.
The chain settles to the ground first.
The air here is far too dry.
I have begun to sway.
Who lit my incense?
Ash leaks from the seams.
I turn half around to see the place.
This place needs a good smoking.
I move from the corner toward the center.

lines.zh: 火焰舔到炉壁，香一下烧旺了。
lines.en: Fire licks the wall and the incense flares.

lines.zh: 我从架上摔下去，铁环撒开。
lines.en: I fall from the shelf and the links scatter.
Water floods the censer and the incense dies.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀翻，灰扬了一空。
lines.en: The blast tips me over and ash fills the air.
An arrow sticks in the censer wall.

lines.zh: 法术钻进炉里，把烟搅散了。
lines.en: The spell gets inside and scatters the smoke.

lines.zh: 香快烧尽，我的烟越来越淡。
lines.en: The incense runs low and my smoke thins.
Lightning runs down the chain into the base.
The chain drops away first.
